requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism is not properly capturing Flask server-side requests. Tests are failing because the Flask routes are not being recorded when server=True is enabled in the httprecord context manager.
requirement.contract: When server=True is specified in httprecord(), Flask server requests should be captured and recorded in the HTTPRecords object. The hook mechanism needs to be enhanced to detect and intercept Flask route handlers and error handlers properly.

requirement.description: The httprecord context manager does not properly handle server-side hooks for Flask applications. The hook sequence needs to be modified to ensure Flask-specific hooks are applied correctly.
requirement.contract: When server=True is specified, the httprecord context manager should apply hooks that capture server-side HTTP requests, particularly for Flask applications. The hook order and application mechanism needs to be adjusted to ensure Flask routes are intercepted.
